text:
samir: Deploybot blocked the 1.12.0 publish, seeing an 'index-archive' lint failure from the registry. Promote is blocked. Need a quick decision: retag/rebuild vs force-promote?

deploy-bot: Publish blocked: registry returned 409 - tag exists with different OCI index/manifest list ordering. Manual review required. See CI report: https://ci/reports/123

michael: Do we have the previous digest available to pin to as a fallback?

samir: Yes the previous digest is still present in the registry, we could pin, but that'd leave the 1.12.0 tag unresolved (release notes already reference 1.12.0).

jen: Root cause: buildkit change reordered platforms in the manifest list, so the new index doesn't match the one the lint expects (archive label absent on one index entry). We can rebuild with stable ordering flag.

rohan: Options: 1) Rebuild with stable-ordering, run a canary, then retag and promote 1.12.0. 2) Force-promote via publishbot override (needs approval and increases risk for downstream caches).

michaela: Holding past the 02:00 UTC change window slides the release. Product is anxious but prefers correctness.

samir: I'd rather avoid force-promote. If rebuild + canary fits the window, do that.

jen: Rebuild + canary should take ~20m for build + 10m for canary watch. I can run it if someone triggers the manual promote for canary only.

deploy-bot: To run a manual canary promote, use: `/deploybot override --reason "canary-only promote" --by rohan`

rohan: I'll take the rebuild and canary. If green, we'll retag to 1.12.0 (new digest) and update the release notes with a short note about 'manifest ordering rebuild'. If it fails, we'll hold and schedule full-window release next day. Assigning to myself.

tara: I'll prepare a short blurb for release notes and notify CS about a possible slide.

samir: Plan: rohan starts rebuild + canary within 30m. If canary passes, retag & promote, update release notes. If fails, hold and roll to next change window. :thumbsup:

michaela: sounds good

rohan: Starting rebuild now. Command: `/ci run build-1.12.0 --stable-ordering` Will post logs here.

ci-bot: CI started: build-1.12.0 (ID 98421). Logs: https://ci/98421

samir: Thanks — keeping this thread as single source of truth. Ping here with green/red and I'll coordinate any customer comms.
__note: This JSON is a single Slack thread: messages concatenated into one string per agents.md rules.
